import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0099 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a ≤ b := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0099 (a b c : Nat) (h1 : a ≤ b + c) (h2 : b ≤ a + c) : a ≤ b := by
  have h3 : a + b ≤ b + c + a + c by
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm c a, add_assoc, add_comm b c]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_left h1.le)
  have h4 : b + a ≤ a + c + b + c by
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm a c, add_assoc, add_comm b c]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (le_add_of_nonneg_left h2.le)
  have h5 : a + b ≤ b + a by
    rw [add_comm a b]
    exact le_refl (a + b)
  have h6 : b + a ≤ a + b by
    rw [add_comm a b]
    exact le_refl (b + a)
  have h7 : a + b = b + a by
    rw [h5, h6]
  have h8 : a + b ≤ a + b by
    rw [h7]
    exact le_refl (a + b)
  have h9 : a ≤ b by
    rw [h8]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_left h3
  exact h9
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0099 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0099 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0099

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0099
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0099
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
